title: China Inflation Picks Up as Energy Costs Rise
description:
“Bloomberg: The China Show” is your definitive source for news and analysis on the world's second-biggest economy. From politics and policy to tech and trends, Yvonne Man and David Ingles give global investors unique insight, delivering in-depth discussions with the newsmakers who matter.

Chapters:
00:00:00 - The China Show Opens
00:03:35 - Brent nears $100 a barrel after US strikes near Kharg Island
00:07:31 - Bessent dares traders to bet against the yen
00:10:03 - Is the yuan starting to stretch?
00:14:22 - US hits Ford over Chinese auto ties
00:16:35 - China stocks show signs of nearing a short-term bottom
00:24:36 - Breaking: China consumer, producer price hikes pick up
00:25:26 - Crédit Agricole's Xiaojia Zhi on China's inflation data
00:36:33 - Former BOK Governor Rhee on the Korean won, China's AI sector
00:50:06 - Bond rush builds as issuers race to avoid headwinds
00:53:10 - Jefferies' Christopher Wood on markets, geopolitical tensions
01:12:03 - MangoBoost's Jangwoo Kim on fundraising plans
01:21:12 - China's IPO lottery creates windfalls for some investors
01:24:03 - Philippine Defense Chief blasts China at Seoul security event
01:29:04 - Modi calls for broader links to India's digital payments network
